source.author: verg
source.text: Ocius adducto torquens hastile lacerto, suspiciens altam Lunam sic voce precatur:
source.text_original: Ocius adducto torquens hastile lacerto, / suspiciens altam Lunam sic voce precatur: /
source.text_english: Quickly, twisting the spearshaft with his arm drawn back, gazing up at the lofty Moon, he thus prays aloud:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illam huc atque illuc nunc torquens verberat Eurus, nunc stridens Zephyris aufert Notus; undique fervent aequora, cum subitus trifida Neptunus in hasta caeruleum fundo caput extulit.
reuse.text_original: illam huc atque illuc nunc torquens verberat Eurus, / nunc stridens Zephyris aufert Notus; undique fervent / aequora, cum subitus trifida Neptunus in hasta / caeruleum fundo caput extulit.
reuse.text_english: Now Eurus, wrenching it hither and thither, beats it, now Notus, screaming among the Zephyrs, carries it off; the seas boil on every side, when suddenly Neptunus, with his three-pronged spear, raised his blue head from the depths.
